summary: Failed jobs explain what went wrong and offer a reviewed one-click fix.

new.title: Engine logs & errors page
new.text: Jobs now has its own Engine logs & errors page with recent runs, full logs and a Failing now list showing each item, why, and what to do.

new.title: One-click fixes, still reviewed
new.text: Failing items offer Remove this row or Make it Eligible. The fix goes to Pending changes and applies only when you commit.

new.title: Project and Cross-org groups
new.text: Direct groups have new Project and Cross-org types. Department and Process groups are created by the engine.

fixes.title: Entra role assignments work again
fixes.text: Entra role assignments made by the scheduled engine are applied again.

fixes.title: Re-issued passes are delivered
fixes.text: A Temporary Access Pass re-issued from the queue is mailed to the account owner's office email. If mail cannot be delivered, the existing pass is left untouched.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Jobs run on their configured schedule, validation gives definite results, Admin accounts fields are clearer, and the admin word no longer loosens name checks.
